title: Mysterious jungle sickness and deafness at Tikal

tellings.quote: And I was 75% deaf in each ear by the end of the trip.

plain: During a 2024 trip to Tikal, the old Maya city in the Guatemalan jungle, a researcher fell ill with a sickness no one could explain and slowly lost most of his hearing. Luke Caverns, a researcher who studies ancient pyramids, tells Michels this happened to him, saying, "I was 75% deaf in each ear by the end of the trip."
